## Statement

Assume the inherited Axiom of Choice. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a projective morphism of complex projective varieties, $X$ smooth of pure complex dimension $n$, and let $k$ be any characteristic-zero coefficient field. Then $Rf_*k_X[n]$ is a finite direct sum of shifts of simple perverse sheaves on $Y$; equivalently all its perverse cohomology objects are semisimple and it splits into their shifted sum. This holds without any assumption that $k$ embeds in $\mathbb C$.

5.1 Absolute projectivity of the target needs no general compactification theorem. Put $D=\bigotimes_{\beta_i>0}\det S_i$; then $S_i^\vee\otimes\det S_i\cong\bigwedge^{\beta_i-1}S_i$, so $\mathcal Hom(S_i,S_j)\otimes D\cong\bigwedge^{\beta_i-1}S_i\otimes S_j\otimes\bigotimes_{l\ne i}\det S_l$, and $D$ itself is a tensor product of the $\det S_l$. Each $S_i\subseteq\mathcal O^{N_i}$ is a subbundle with locally free quotient, hence so are its exterior powers, and tensor products of such subbundles are again subbundles of finite trivial bundles with locally free quotients; therefore $(E_N\oplus\mathcal O)\otimes D$ is a subbundle of a finite trivial bundle $\mathcal O^M$. Since $D$ is a line bundle, twisting identifies $\mathbb P_{\rm lines}((E_N\oplus\mathcal O)\otimes D)=\mathbb P_{\rm lines}(E_N\oplus\mathcal O)$, which is thus a closed subvariety of the smooth projective $B_N\times\mathbb P^{M-1}$ by [F1] and [F4], hence smooth and projective. [F1, F4, step 4.3, algebra, construct]
